# Anupam Mondal

> Web designer, web developer and SEO consultant in Sonarpur, Kolkata (West Bengal, India), working since 2016. Builds websites, web apps and SaaS products for Indian and international clients.

## Products
- [ResortDesk: resort and homestay booking software for India](https://anupammondal.in/resortdesk/resort-booking-software): online booking and quotes, UPI QR payments, GST booking vouchers and tax invoices, multi-night stays, veg or non-veg meals by night, items by day, a Today screen and a kitchen day sheet. Plans from ₹2,499/month + GST. Live at The Frozen Garden Village Resort (book.thefrozengarden.in).
- [Cloud School Management System](https://anupammondal.in/sms/school-management-system): school ERP for attendance, fees, exams and parent communication.
- [Smart SEO Booster](https://anupammondal.in/wordpress-plugin/smart-seo-booster): WordPress plugin for SEO audits and schema checks.
